description: The ELSE arm of 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS at app/cbl/CBACT01C.cbl:L184-L187 - the arm that zero-fills and renders the two-digit status - pinned at the fatal open call site. THIS CASE AND case10 ARE A PAIR AND NOT A COPY: they reach the same paragraph from the same call site and diverge at its one guard, so between them they pin both arms and the choice between them. case10 reports AccountRepository.PERMANENT_ERROR_STATUS, whose first byte is the character '9' and whose second is a raw 0x00, and takes the EXTENDED arm at :L179-L183 for FILE STATUS IS: NNNN9000. This one reports '35' and takes the ELSE arm for FILE STATUS IS: NNNN0035. Before the declared stimulus existed the two were byte-identical in every member and the ELSE arm was reached by nothing in this directory; that is what this case now fixes. HOW THE STATUS IS INDUCED, DECLARED RATHER THAN INFERRED FROM AN ABSENT DATASET: unitStimulus.callSiteOutcomes names OPEN-ACCTFILE reporting FILE STATUS '35' - the z/OS status for an OPEN INPUT of a dataset that is not there. It has to be declared, because omitting the input is the only other way this harness reaches a failing OPEN and an absent relation reports AccountRepository.PERMANENT_ERROR_STATUS, which is '9'-prefixed and therefore reaches the extended arm and only the extended arm. Every status the DATA itself can produce is either '00' or that permanent error, so no arrangement of seeded rows reaches :L184-L186 at all. The seam is deliberately narrow: the gate refuses a declared status that is '00' (the seeded relation already produces it) and refuses one beginning '9' (it would duplicate case10 rather than distinguish this case), and it refuses a RESP, a refusal or a record count, because CBACT01C is a batch program reached by EXEC PGM= in app/jcl/READACCT.jcl and its OPEN reports a two-character FILE STATUS. The dataset IS declared here, with one row, so the failure is unambiguously the declared open status rather than a missing relation. THE PATH, STATEMENT BY STATEMENT: 0000-ACCTFILE-OPEN at :L133-L149 moves 8 into APPL-RESULT at :L134, issues OPEN INPUT at :L135, tests the status against '00' and nothing else at :L136 so :L139 moves 12, and fails the APPL-AOK guard at :L141: DISPLAY 'ERROR OPENING ACCTFILE' at :L144 - the bare DD name, and not ACCOUNT FILE as the read literal at :L110 and the close literal at :L162 are - then MOVE ACCTFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS at :L145, PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS at :L146 and PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM at :L147, which displays 'ABENDING PROGRAM' at :L170, moves 0 into TIMING at :L171 and 999 into ABCODE at :L172, and calls 'CEE3ABD' at :L173. ABCODE 999 and TIMING 0 are Language Environment abend parameters and are never the return code: the return code is 12, from the MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT at :L139, carried out of the program by that call. WHICH ARM, AND WHY THIS ONE: the guard at :L177-L178 is IF IO-STATUS NOT NUMERIC OR IO-STAT1 = '9'. The status '35' is two printable digits, so the class condition IO-STATUS NOT NUMERIC is FALSE; and its first byte is '3', so IO-STAT1 = '9' is FALSE too. Both halves of the OR fail, which is the only way control reaches :L184. That makes this case the negative control for case10's guard as well as the positive test of the arm: case10 satisfies BOTH halves of the OR and this one satisfies NEITHER, so a translation that had collapsed the guard to a single test - or inverted it - fails one of the pair whichever way it collapsed. DERIVING THE FOUR-BYTE IMAGE: 01 IO-STATUS-04 is IO-STATUS-0401 PIC 9 followed by IO-STATUS-0403 PIC 999 at :L57-L59, four bytes in all. (1) MOVE '0000' TO IO-STATUS-04 at :L185 fills all four with the character zero. (2) MOVE IO-STATUS TO IO-STATUS-04(3:2) at :L186 overwrites bytes 3 and 4 with the two status characters, leaving bytes 1 and 2 as the '00' step 1 wrote. The image is therefore '0035'. (3) DISPLAY 'FILE STATUS IS: NNNN' IO-STATUS-04 at :L187 concatenates the 20-character literal with those four bytes into a 24-character line, FILE STATUS IS: NNNN0035. The NNNN is part of the hard-coded literal at :L183 and :L187 and stays verbatim; it is not a placeholder awaiting substitution. Note that this arm performs NO binary packing at all - no TWO-BYTES-BINARY, no REDEFINES, no unsigned widening - which is precisely what distinguishes it: a translation that ran every status through the extended arm's packing would render '35' as '3' followed by the unsigned value of 0x35, that is 9053, and fail here. WHAT IS NOT HERE: nothing is read, because the OPEN failed before 1000-ACCTFILE-GET-NEXT is ever performed - so no labelled field line, no 49-hyphen separator and no 300-byte record image appears, and the single seeded row is displayed nowhere. :L173 terminates the program before the closing banner at :L85, so the END OF EXECUTION line appears nowhere. SYSOUT is exactly these four lines, of 38, 22, 24 and 16 characters. Nothing is written anywhere - the empty expectedWrites asserts that positively - and the run does not reach 9000-ACCTFILE-CLOSE either - but the dataset was described and its one row survives untouched, so expectedFinalState pins that row byte for byte. The final state is OBSERVED on every run rather than only where a case asks for it, so a case that declined to pin a surviving row would fail with an EXTRA_DATASET difference rather than pass in silence: an empty expectation is a positive assertion that nothing was produced. No job parameter is declared, because app/jcl/READACCT.jcl:L22 is a bare EXEC PGM=CBACT01C with no PARM. No fully-qualified dataset name appears: a case addresses a dataset by binding key alone, and the key this program uses is ACCTFILE, declared at app/jcl/READACCT.jcl:L25. Every expected line is US-ASCII - the code page of app/data/ASCII and of ParityHarness.FIXTURE_CHARSET - and never a platform default. The case is deterministic: it carries no wall-clock and no random value, and the condition it forces is declared rather than computed, so repeated runs produce the same four lines. PROVENANCE: statically derived by structured reading of app/cbl/CBACT01C.cbl, cross-checked against app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy for the 300-byte record this run never reaches and app/jcl/READACCT.jcl for the DD and the absent PARM, and against the constants published by AccountBalanceJob, AbendException, AccountRepository and FileStatus. Nothing here was captured from, recorded against or replayed from any execution of the legacy COBOL, which is empirically impossible in this environment: there is no z/OS runtime, the available compiler reports its indexed file handler as disabled, and no Language Environment CEE service exists to link the CALL 'CEE3ABD' at :L173. That substitution of provenance, and nothing else about the gate, is the escalated deviation recorded as risk R-A.
